name: Donald F. Samuel
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: Donald F. Samuel is an attorney who represents clients in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Donald Samuel is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Donald Samuel chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Georgia School of Law and graduated in 1980. Donald Samuel passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1980.
He represents clients with Criminal Defense issues in Georgia. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Donald Samuel has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
